scientific_integrity: Explicit countably atomic probability-preserving system, exact combinatorial formula, proof of critical moment thresholds; numerical checker uses finite truncated systems and is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The system is nonergodic and noncompact; no mixing claim is made.

Global normalized mean and variance are proved infinite only in stated parameter ranges; outside those ranges a single chosen generator has finite moments but the system-level supremum is not bounded.
Historical priority remains subject to an independent check; finite computation is not an infinite proof.
title: A zero-entropy atomic system with infinite admissible return-time invariants
